proofEvidence.authentication: The live K3s metrics-server is Ready, authenticates to kubelets with its ServiceAccount identity, and successfully publishes fresh node CPU and memory through metrics.k8s.io.
proofEvidence.authorization: Kubernetes v1.36 maps GET /metrics and GET /metrics/* to core nodes/metrics get. nodes/proxy is both unnecessary and unsafe. The future Prometheus identity currently has none of the deferred node permissions.
proofEvidence.tls: The live metrics-server selects InternalIP and has no kubelet-insecure-tls flag, proving strict TLS works for its path. H8.4C-KR could not inspect the selected certificate because the configured key fingerprint SHA256:UZH/Hevwku3TViA+ZhZWLa4MmOvactH0maZ+iTd5n9w was not present in the agent; only SHA256:r2aP6c1jw5kcvOaJQPikUNb2VDzzIjywLQpICflPCPw was loaded, so no SSH retry was made.
proofEvidence.networkPolicy: H8.4B0 proves 142.132.178.45/32 as the post-DNAT node destination for API TCP 6443, but no deployment-specific rule inspection establishes Pod-to-local-node TCP 10250 enforcement. SSH host inspection did not run because the matching key was absent from the agent.
proofEvidence.schemaInspection: One API-proxied /metrics request retained only selected family names and label-key names; no values, timestamps or raw payload were retained.

strict verification and optional server_name configuration for Prometheus itself
effective kube-router enforcement of exact 142.132.178.45/32 TCP 10250 from the Prometheus Pod identity
